title_zh: 雷军同日到访宇树科技与 B 站，分别与王兴兴、陈睿交流
content_zh:
据《科创板日报》报道，小米创始人雷军 9 月 14 日在王兴兴陪同下探访宇树科技，并观看人形机器人表演。公开信息没有披露双方是否讨论投资、产品合作或其他具体安排。

雷军同日还到访 B 站上海总部，与 B 站董事长陈睿交流。现场大屏打出「欢迎 B 站 UP 主雷军」的标语。陈睿早年加入金山软件时曾担任雷军的技术助理；此次访问的具体议题同样未公开。
title_en: Xiaomi Founder Lei Jun Visits Unitree Robotics and Bilibili in Busy Shanghai Tour
content_en:
Xiaomi founder Lei Jun made high-profile visits to both Unitree Robotics and Bilibili on September 14, sparking speculation about potential collaborations, though no official details have been disclosed.

During his visit to Unitree Robotics, Lei was accompanied by founder Wang Xingxing and watched a demonstration of the company's humanoid robots. Public records did not reveal whether the two parties discussed investments, product partnerships, or other specific arrangements.

On the same day, Lei visited Bilibili's Shanghai headquarters, where he met with Chairman and CEO Chen Rui. The office welcomed him with a screen reading "Welcome Bilibili Creator Lei Jun." Notably, Chen served as Lei's technical assistant during his early days at Kingsoft. The specific agenda of their meeting remains undisclosed.

title_zh: 微信回应「小微」隐私争议：仅按用户指令临时读取指定聊天
content_zh:
9 月 15 日，微信员工「客村小蒋」回应 AI 助手「小微」的隐私争议称，小微能接触的信息不会超过用户本人可查看的范围，所谓「直接读取聊天记录」和「偷看所有隐私」的说法不实。

按照回应，小微只有在聊天场景中由用户主动发起「问小微」时，才会从微信客户端本地临时读取用户指定的聊天记录，用于分析和总结；原始聊天记录不会保存。公众号、视频号等内容推荐可参考关注、浏览和互动数据，但同样受用户权限范围约束。

小微由微信团队开发，目前仍在小范围内测，可通过文字或语音查询天气、快递和外卖，也能在朋友圈、公众号、聊天和视频号等场景被唤起。
title_en: WeChat Addresses Privacy Concerns Over AI Assistant 'Xiaowei'
content_en:
WeChat has responded to privacy concerns surrounding its new AI assistant, "Xiaowei," clarifying that the assistant does not actively snoop on users' private data. On September 15, WeChat staff member "Kecun Xiaojiang" refuted claims that the AI "directly reads chat history" or "steals all privacy."

According to the response, Xiaowei only accesses chat logs locally and temporarily when a user explicitly triggers the "Ask Xiaowei" feature within a chat. This data is used solely for analysis and summarization, and the original chat logs are never stored. Content recommendations on WeChat Channels and Official Accounts may reference user interactions, but these remain strictly within the user's permission settings.

Developed by the WeChat team, Xiaowei is currently in a limited closed beta. The AI assistant can handle text or voice queries for weather, package tracking, and food delivery, and can be summoned across various scenarios, including Moments, chats, and Channels.

title_zh: Google 向全体工程师开放 Claude，Gemini 仍是默认模型
content_zh:
据 Business Insider 报道，Google 已向全体工程师开放 Anthropic 的 Claude。Google 发言人确认，工程师现在可以通过内部开发工具 Antigravity 使用 Opus 5 模型；过去只有部分 DeepMind 与高优先级团队拥有相关权限。

Claude 在公司内部设有每位用户的使用配额，定位是补充工具，Gemini 仍是默认和主要模型。

Google 此前通常不允许大多数员工在工作中使用外部 AI 工具。这次扩大权限，为工程师比较不同模型的编程表现提供了正式渠道，也让 Claude 从少数团队使用的例外工具变成全体工程师可申请使用的补充选项。
title_en: Google Opens Anthropic's Claude to All Engineers as a Supplementary Tool
content_en:
Google has granted all of its engineers access to Anthropic's Claude model, marking a significant shift in its internal AI policy. A Google spokesperson confirmed that engineers can now access the Claude Opus model through "Antigravity," an internal development tool. Previously, this access was restricted to Google DeepMind and other high-priority teams.

While Claude is now widely available, it comes with individual usage quotas and is positioned strictly as a supplementary tool. Google's in-house Gemini model remains the default and primary AI assistant for its developers.

Historically, Google has restricted employees from using external AI tools for work. This expansion provides a formal channel for engineers to compare coding performance across different models, transitioning Claude from an exclusive exception to a widely accessible resource.

title_zh: 黄仁勋活动现场免提接听特朗普电话，双方隔空探讨 AI
content_zh:
9 月 14 日在洛杉矶举行的 All-in Summit 峰会上，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在演讲期间接听了美国总统特朗普打来的免提电话。

通话中，特朗普将 AI 末日论称为「骗局」，表示机器人绝不可能统治世界，并批评了放缓 AI 发展速度的主张，认为此类呼吁出于政治动机。

特朗普还提到自己在麻省理工学院任教四十余年的叔叔约翰·乔治·特朗普，称自己凭借家族基因遗传也具备相应天赋，因而深谙 AI 领域；黄仁勋在现场回应称「难怪你对 AI 这么懂」。

另据《金融时报》报道，黄仁勋在 Salesforce 年度 Dreamforce 大会上就 AI 安全与监管议题表达了不同路径。

针对此前 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 呼吁行业放缓新模型开发速度，以及马斯克和 OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 公开支持控制研发节奏的提议，黄仁勋表示不同意将减速作为行业通用方案。

黄仁勋将 AI 安全定义为工程问题，主张在产品失控时暂停处置、确认可控后继续研发，将评估和防护持续嵌入开发流程，而非停止技术演进。在监管层面，他认为现有法律和市场机制足以约束产品责任，无需单独为 AI 设立一套新法律。
title_en: Jensen Huang Takes On-Stage Call from Trump, Shares Views on AI Safety and Regulation
content_en:
During the All-in Summit in Los Angeles on September 14, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang took a surprise hands-free phone call from Donald Trump while on stage. During the call, Trump dismissed AI doomsday theories as a "hoax," asserting that robots would never rule the world, and criticized calls to slow down AI development as politically motivated. Trump also cited his uncle, a longtime MIT professor, to claim his own genetic aptitude for understanding AI, to which Huang humorously replied, "No wonder you understand AI so well."

Separately, at Salesforce's annual Dreamforce conference, Huang shared his perspective on AI safety and regulation, diverging from other industry leaders. While figures like Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, Elon Musk, and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman have advocated for slowing down development, Huang disagreed with deceleration as a universal approach.

Huang framed AI safety as an engineering challenge rather than a regulatory bottleneck. He argued that developers should pause and fix issues when they arise, then continue development, integrating evaluation and safeguards throughout the process. Regarding regulation, Huang believes existing laws and market mechanisms are sufficient to govern product liability, making AI-specific legislation unnecessary.

title_zh: 鸿蒙智行确认问界合作模式调整，赛力斯主导五项业务
content_zh:
9 月 15 日，鸿蒙智行发布问界合作模式说明。即日起，问界的产品定义、产品设计、品牌营销、渠道零售和服务体系改由赛力斯主导，华为终端参与赋能。

鸿蒙智行表示，问界仍是鸿蒙智行成员，现有用户权益及后续服务不受影响。此次调整也不涉及其他品牌，尊界、享界、智界和尚界仍采用华为全流程主导的合作模式。

这份说明确认了当天早些时候有关双方合作模式变化的报道，同时把调整范围限定在问界，并明确了华为在新模式中的角色。
title_en: Seres to Take the Lead in Aito Partnership as Huawei Adjusts Collaboration Model
content_en:
On September 15, Harmony Intelligent Mobility Alliance (HIMA) announced a restructuring of its partnership model for the Aito brand. Effective immediately, Seres will take the lead in five core business areas: product definition, product design, brand marketing, retail channels, and service systems. Huawei's terminal division will transition to a supporting, enabling role.

HIMA assured that Aito remains a member of the alliance, and existing customer benefits and services will not be affected.

This adjustment is exclusive to the Aito brand. Other HIMA collaborative brands—including Stelato, Luxeed, and Maextro—will continue to operate under the Huawei-led, full-process collaboration model.

title_zh: Disney 要求更多远程产品与技术员工每周到岗四天
content_zh:
据 Business Insider 报道，Disney 部分原本远程工作的产品与技术员工 9 月 14 日收到通知，今后需要每周到办公室工作四天。

Disney 现行公司政策本就以每周四天到岗为主，但不同团队的执行存在差异，部分员工一直获准远程工作。此次通知针对部分岗位，并非面向全公司的新制度。公司正在推进「One Disney」协作方式，希望不同业务团队使用更统一的工作流程。
title_en: Disney Mandates Four-Day In-Office Week for More Remote Tech and Product Staff
content_en:
Walt Disney Co. has notified a portion of its remote product and technology employees that they will be required to work from the office four days a week, according to a report by Business Insider on September 14.

While Disney's corporate policy already favors a four-day in-office schedule, enforcement has previously varied by department, allowing some staff to remain fully remote. The latest mandate targets specific roles rather than representing a company-wide policy change.

The move is part of the company's "One Disney" initiative, which aims to foster closer collaboration and unify workflows across its various business divisions.

title_zh: 第一财经调查：AI 短剧「融合脸」增加肖像侵权举证难度
content_zh:
第一财经 9 月 15 日发布的调查显示，一些 AI 仿真人短剧制作方使用「真人打底」、「融合脸」和「垫图」，将多张人脸的五官特征混合，或在真人底图上修改肤色、年龄和轮廓。这类图像介于「像」与「不像」之间，让普通人更难证明 AI 角色使用了自己的肖像。

法院认定肖像权侵权的核心标准是「可识别性」。受访律师指出，当脸部特征被混合和深度修改后，受害者往往缺少足够的影像样本与技术鉴定支持；即使诉讼成功，赔偿也可能只能覆盖公证、律师和误工成本。

调查还发现，部分头部模型已会拦截过于接近真人的生成请求，但制作方可借助境外服务或自行部署的开源模型绕开过滤。对已上架的侵权内容，平台当前多在收到投诉后下架处理。
title_en: AI-Generated "Fused Faces" in Short Dramas Create Legal Hurdles for Portrait Rights
content_en:
An investigation by Yicai reveals that AI short drama producers are increasingly using "fused faces"—blending facial features of multiple individuals or altering real photos—to create AI characters. This technique makes it significantly harder for individuals to prove portrait infringement, as the resulting faces fall into a gray area of resemblance.

Under current legal standards, proving portrait infringement relies heavily on "identifiability." Lawyers note that victims of fused-face AI generation struggle to provide sufficient image samples or technical evidence to prove their likeness was stolen. Furthermore, even if victims win in court, the compensation often barely covers legal, notary, and lost-work expenses.

While major AI models have implemented filters to block requests that closely mimic real people, creators easily bypass these restrictions using open-source models or overseas services. Currently, hosting platforms primarily rely on a reactive "take-down upon complaint" approach to address infringing content.

title_zh: Waymo 计划 2027 年在东京推出全无人出租车
content_zh:
Waymo、日本交通与出行平台 GO 9 月 15 日宣布达成战略合作，计划于 2027 年在东京推出 Level 4 全无人出租车服务。按日方公告的目标，这将是日本首个全无人商业出租车项目。

三家公司自 2025 年起在东京 7 个区开展公路测试，由受训练的日本交通司机在车内监督，帮助 Waymo Driver 适应窄路、人群密集路段等本地道路环境。商业化后，乘客将可通过 GO 或 Waymo 应用叫车，服务计划 24 小时运行。
title_en: Waymo Partners with GO to Launch Fully Autonomous Robotaxis in Tokyo by 2027
content_en:
Waymo and Japanese mobility platform GO have announced a strategic partnership to launch Level 4 fully autonomous robotaxi services in Tokyo by 2027. The initiative aims to become Japan's first fully commercialized driverless taxi service.

To prepare for the launch, the companies will begin public road testing in 2025 across seven of Tokyo's districts. During this phase, trained local drivers will remain in the vehicles to supervise and help the Waymo Driver system adapt to Tokyo's unique driving environments, such as narrow streets and heavily crowded areas.

Once the service goes live commercially, passengers will be able to hail the 24/7 autonomous rides through either the GO or Waymo mobile apps.

title_zh: 曝 OpenAI 雇佣数百名外包人员审阅 ChatGPT 对话
content_zh:
据 404 Media 根据内部文件和实际提示词报道，OpenAI 正通过代号为「Project Lily」的项目，让数百名外包人员审阅 ChatGPT 用户的真实提示词，部分任务会呈现完整对话。审阅员需对模型回复进行打分和评论，用于改进回复质量，包括减少谄媚倾向和对模型的拟人化表述。

这些材料不向审阅员显示 ChatGPT 用户名。OpenAI 表示，对话在送往审阅前会经过 Privacy Filter 处理，但敏感个人信息仍可能漏过过滤。Anthropic 也向 404 Media 确认，其会使用人工审阅来改进模型。

OpenAI 的数据控制说明显示，个人版 ChatGPT 和 Codex 的对话可用于改进模型；用户可在「设置」的「数据控制」中关闭「为所有用户改进模型」，之后的新对话将不再用于训练。
title_en: OpenAI's "Project Lily" Employs Contractors to Review Real ChatGPT Conversations
content_en:
OpenAI is reportedly running a secret initiative codenamed "Project Lily," employing hundreds of external contractors to review real ChatGPT user prompts and full conversations, according to a report by 404 Media. The contractors rate and comment on AI responses to improve quality, specifically targeting issues like sycophancy and anthropomorphism.

While OpenAI strips usernames and applies a privacy filter before sending data to reviewers, the company acknowledges that sensitive personal information could still slip through. Anthropic, a major rival, also confirmed to 404 Media that it utilizes human reviewers for similar model-improvement purposes.

Users concerned about privacy can opt out of having their data used for model training. By disabling the "Improve the model for everyone" setting in ChatGPT's Data Controls, future conversations will no longer be saved or reviewed for training.

title_zh: 环球音乐起诉 DistroKid，指控其放任 AI 音乐与侵权录音涌入平台
content_zh:
环球音乐集团与旗下 Capitol Records 9 月 15 日在美国特拉华联邦法院起诉 DistroKid，指控这家音乐分发商实施欺骗性商业行为并持续分发侵权录音。

诉状把「明确标注的 AI 生成音乐」与冒充真人音乐人作品的内容区分开来。环球音乐称，DistroKid 让流媒体平台误以为其分发内容由真实音乐人创作并持有权利，同时在已经承认无权分发部分录音后，仍将相同内容送往其他服务。

环球音乐列举了 1000 首具体录音，并称这只是全部问题的一部分。DistroKid 自称为超过 400 万名音乐人分发内容，约占全球新发行音乐的 40%；诉讼将让音乐分发平台对 AI 内容标注、版权核验和反刷量的责任边界受到进一步审视。
title_en: Universal Music Sues DistroKid Over AI Music and Copyright Infringement
content_en:
Universal Music Group (UMG) and its subsidiary Capitol Records have filed a lawsuit against music distributor DistroKid in a Delaware federal court, accusing the platform of deceptive business practices and distributing infringing recordings.

The lawsuit distinguishes between clearly labeled AI-generated music and content that impersonates real artists. UMG alleges that DistroKid misled streaming platforms into believing its distributed content was created and owned by legitimate artists. Furthermore, UMG claims that DistroKid continued to send infringing tracks to other services even after acknowledging it lacked the rights to distribute them.

While UMG has identified 1,000 specific infringing recordings, it notes this is only a fraction of the overall issue. DistroKid, which claims to distribute music for over 4 million artists—representing roughly 40% of all new global releases—now faces intense scrutiny over its responsibilities regarding AI content labeling, copyright verification, and streaming fraud prevention.

title_zh: Cornelis 完成 2.05 亿美元融资，推出可边计算边传输的 AI 网络
content_zh:
AI 网络公司 Cornelis 9 月 14 日宣布完成 2.05 亿美元融资，由 IAG Capital Partners 领投。公司同时推出 Active Compute Fabric，试图减少 GPU 等待数据传输时产生的空转。

据 TechCrunch 报道，这套网络允许芯片在处理数据的同时发送信息，并采用开放架构，可搭配不同厂商的 GPU 和加速器。Cornelis 于 2020 年从 Intel 分拆，现有产品已经开始出货，下一代产品计划于今年晚些时候推出。
title_en: AI Networking Startup Cornelis Raises $205 Million, Launches Active Compute Fabric
content_en:
AI networking company Cornelis has secured $205 million in a funding round led by IAG Capital Partners. Alongside the funding, the company unveiled its "Active Compute Fabric," designed to minimize GPU idle time caused by data transmission bottlenecks.

According to TechCrunch, this new networking technology enables chips to transmit data while simultaneously processing it. Built on an open architecture, the fabric is compatible with GPUs and accelerators from various hardware vendors.

Spun out of Intel in 2020, Cornelis is already shipping its current generation of products, with its next-generation lineup scheduled for release later this year.

title_zh: Altera 已秘密提交美国 IPO 申请，拟募资超过 20 亿美元
content_zh:
Altera 9 月 15 日确认，已秘密提交美国首次公开募股申请。路透社此前报道称，这家由 Silver Lake 和英特尔持股的芯片公司最快可能在今年完成上市，募资规模或超过 20 亿美元。

Altera 生产用于数据中心、通信网络、工业设备、AI、航空航天与国防系统的可编程芯片。Silver Lake 持有公司 51% 股份，英特尔保留 49%。根据秘密提交机制，公司可以在临近上市时再公开财务材料。
title_en: Intel-Backed Chipmaker Altera Confidentially Files for US IPO to Raise Over $2 Billion
content_en:
Chipmaker Altera has officially confirmed that it has confidentially filed for an initial public offering (IPO) in the United States. According to previous reports, the company could go public as early as this year, aiming to raise more than $2 billion.

Altera specializes in manufacturing programmable chips (FPGAs) used across data centers, telecommunications, industrial equipment, artificial intelligence, and aerospace and defense systems. Private equity firm Silver Lake currently holds a 51% majority stake in the company, while Intel retains the remaining 49%.

By utilizing the confidential filing process, Altera can keep its detailed financial information private until closer to its actual market debut.

title_zh: Factory 完成 2 亿美元融资，估值升至 50 亿美元
content_zh:
AI 编程 Agent 公司 Factory 9 月 15 日宣布完成 2 亿美元融资，投后估值为 50 亿美元。Blackstone、Khosla Ventures、红杉资本、Insight Partners 等机构参与，公司累计融资额已超过 4 亿美元。

Factory 表示，新资金将用于研究、产品和全球市场扩张。其产品面向企业软件开发团队，可在云端、本地或完全隔离的环境中部署，并允许企业控制系统使用哪些模型、如何学习以及在哪里运行。

公司称，目前已有英伟达、Adobe、T-Mobile、加拿大皇家银行等客户使用其平台。Factory 今年还推出了按任务自动选择模型的 Router，并称该功能在维持性能的同时可将 token 成本降低超过 60%。
title_en: AI Coding Startup Factory Raises $200M at $5B Valuation
content_en:
Factory, an AI software development agent startup, has raised $200 million in a new funding round, boosting its post-money valuation to $5 billion. The round saw participation from major investors including Blackstone, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Insight Partners, bringing the company's total funding to over $400 million.

The newly acquired capital will be used to accelerate research, product development, and global market expansion. Factory's platform is designed for enterprise software development teams, offering flexible deployment options across cloud, on-premise, or fully air-gapped environments. It also gives enterprises full control over model selection, learning processes, and execution environments.

Factory's client roster already includes major names such as Nvidia, Adobe, T-Mobile, and the Royal Bank of Canada. Earlier this year, the company introduced "Router," a feature that automatically selects the most suitable model for a given task, reportedly cutting token costs by over 60% without compromising performance.

title_zh: 💡 朱啸虎：办公 Agent 的竞争会延续协同办公平台格局
content_zh:
金沙江创投朱啸虎在《深网》的访谈中判断，办公 Agent 更有可能由大厂主导。他认为，企业微信、飞书和钉钉等平台已经掌握组织关系、历史聊天与企业知识库，这些上下文会成为办公 Agent 的底层壁垒；创业公司的机会更可能出现在足够深、平台不愿或无法自行覆盖的垂直领域。

朱啸虎同时认为，基础模型能力正在收敛，模型最终会像公共事业一样商品化，应用层的竞争将回到入口、获客、数据沉淀和生态协同。他建议投资者用收入增速、经常性收入质量和现金回报周期区分产业需求与个别公司的估值泡沫。

他认为，编程 Agent 的需求虽然明确，但 API 客户可以迅速切换到效果相近、成本更低的模型，因此收入的可持续性要比短期增速更重要。对应用层创业者，他更看重执行速度、增长曲线和产品对用户专有数据的沉淀能力。

对人形机器人，他认为当前企业数量多、差异小，真实商业订单比例仍低；未来的胜出者可能更依赖供应链、渠道和品牌，而不只是早期技术领先。
title_en: GSR Ventures' Allen Zhu: Big Tech Will Dominate Office AI Agents, Model Capabilities Are Converging
content_en:
Allen Zhu, Managing Director of GSR Ventures, shared his outlook on the AI industry in a recent interview. He predicted that the office AI Agent market will likely be dominated by tech giants. Platforms like WeChat Work (WeCom), Feishu (Lark), and DingTalk already control organizational structures, chat histories, and corporate knowledge bases. This rich contextual data forms an insurmountable barrier for startups, leaving smaller players to find opportunities in deep vertical niches that tech giants cannot or choose not to cover.

Zhu noted that foundation model capabilities are rapidly converging, meaning models will eventually become commoditized like public utilities. Consequently, competition in the application layer will shift back to traditional business metrics: user entry points, customer acquisition, data accumulation, and ecosystem synergy. He advised investors to evaluate startups based on revenue growth rates, the quality of recurring revenue, and cash payback cycles to filter out valuation bubbles.

While acknowledging the clear demand for coding Agents, Zhu warned that API-based customers can quickly switch to cheaper, comparable models. Therefore, revenue sustainability is far more critical than short-term growth. For application-layer entrepreneurs, he prioritizes execution speed, growth trajectories, and the product's ability to lock in proprietary user data.

Regarding humanoid robotics, Zhu expressed caution, noting that the sector is currently crowded with highly similar players and very few actual commercial orders. He believes future winners will succeed based on supply chain efficiency, distribution channels, and brand power, rather than early-stage technological advantages.

title_zh: 小米 18 Pro 系列官宣本月发布，将升级背屏功能
content_zh:
小米集团总裁卢伟冰 9 月 15 日宣布，小米 18 Pro 系列将于本月发布，并开始预热全新「百变背屏」。他表示，新机将在性能、影像、续航和 AI 方面升级，本轮预热的核心信息是背屏方案。

卢伟冰披露，上代「妙享背屏」每日调用应用卡片超过 400 万次，背屏壁纸单日添加量超过 350 万张。小米将在今年改用更先进的方案，并继续公布背屏功能。
title_en: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series Set for September Launch with Upgraded Rear Screen
content_en:
Xiaomi Group President Lu Weibing announced that the flagship Xiaomi 18 Pro series will officially launch this month. The upcoming release will feature significant upgrades in performance, camera capabilities, battery life, and AI integration.

A key highlight of the teaser campaign is the newly upgraded "versatile rear screen." According to Lu, the previous generation's rear screen was highly popular, averaging over 4 million daily application card interactions and more than 3.5 million daily wallpaper changes.

For the Xiaomi 18 Pro series, the company plans to introduce a more advanced rear-screen solution, with further details on its features and capabilities expected to be revealed in the coming days.

title_zh: 腾势 N8L 的「迪迪虾」接入支付宝，可用语音完成点单与停车缴费
content_zh:
支付宝 9 月 15 日宣布，其 AI 智能体「阿宝」已接入比亚迪超级智能体「迪迪虾」。腾势 N8L 车主可在车内用语音发起买咖啡、缴停车费或领周边优惠券等指令，由迪迪虾理解需求，再交给阿宝匹配服务并完成前置流程。

交易仍需用户核对信息，并通过手动确认或声纹核身授权。双方表示，迪迪虾不掌握用户的支付宝账号与资金信息，阿宝也不操作车机及无关第三方应用。

迪迪虾首搭于 9 月 14 日上市的腾势 N8L 纯电版，并兼容 A2A、MCP 等协议；除支付宝外，首批生态伙伴还包括网易云音乐、火山引擎和智能家居服务商。
title_en: BYD's Denza N8L Integrates Alipay AI for Voice-Activated Ordering and Parking Payments
content_en:
Alipay announced on September 15 that its AI agent, "Abao," has integrated with BYD's super AI agent, "Di Di Xia." This integration allows drivers of the Denza N8L to use voice commands for tasks such as ordering coffee, paying parking fees, and claiming local coupons.

Under the system, Di Di Xia processes the user's voice request and hands it over to Abao to match the service and complete the preliminary steps. For security, transactions still require user verification and authorization via manual confirmation or voiceprint. Both companies emphasized that Di Di Xia does not access users' Alipay accounts or financial data, and Abao does not control the vehicle's system or unrelated third-party applications.

Di Di Xia made its debut on the all-electric Denza N8L, which launched on September 14. In addition to Alipay, the AI agent's initial ecosystem partners include NetEase Cloud Music, Volcano Engine, and various smart home service providers.

title_zh: 微信开源企业知识库 WeKnora，支持飞书、企微等接入
content_zh:
微信团队开源了企业级知识库框架 WeKnora，定位为基于大语言模型的知识管理工具，可将企业内部的各类资料转换为可检索、可推理的 Agentic 知识库。

WeKnora 支持 PDF、Word、Excel、图片等多种文件格式，同时可同步飞书、Notion、GitLab、语雀等数据源，并接入企业微信、飞书、Slack 等聊天工具，方便直接在日常工作场景中调用知识库内容。

功能方面，WeKnora 主要围绕 RAG 知识问答、Agent 智能体和自动 Wiki 三部分展开。其中，RAG 可从资料中检索相关内容、回答问题并提供来源；Agent 能反复查阅资料，并结合联网搜索、MCP、Skills 等工具执行复杂任务；自动 Wiki 则可以从大量资料中提取人物、产品、概念等信息，进一步整理为相互关联的 Wiki 页面和知识图谱。

模型方面，WeKnora 支持 OpenAI、DeepSeek、Qwen、智谱、混元、Gemini、MiniMax、Ollama 等，也支持自行部署。目前项目已经在 GitHub 开源，采用 MIT 协议。
title_en: WeChat Open-Sources WeKnora, an AI-Powered Enterprise Knowledge Base Supporting Slack and Feishu
content_en:
The WeChat team has open-sourced WeKnora, an enterprise-grade knowledge base framework powered by large language models (LLMs). Designed as an agentic knowledge management tool, WeKnora converts internal corporate documents into searchable and reasoning-capable knowledge bases.

The framework supports various file formats, including PDF, Word, Excel, and images. It can synchronize data from platforms like Feishu, Notion, GitLab, and Yuque, and integrates directly with collaboration tools such as WeChat Work, Feishu, and Slack, allowing users to access knowledge seamlessly within their daily workflows.

WeKnora offers three core capabilities:

* **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Q&A**: Retrieves relevant content from documents to answer queries with source citations.
* **AI Agents**: Performs complex tasks by repeatedly querying documents and utilizing web search, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and custom skills.
* **Auto Wiki**: Extracts entities like people, products, and concepts from massive datasets to generate interconnected Wiki pages and knowledge graphs.

The framework supports a wide range of LLMs, including OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Zhipu, Hunyuan, Gemini, MiniMax, and Ollama, alongside self-hosted models. WeKnora is currently available on GitHub under the MIT license.

title_zh: 拓竹将发布首款激光雕刻切割机 R1
content_zh:
拓竹宣布，将于 9 月 22 日 22:00 发布 R1，这是该公司首款激光雕刻和切割产品。拓竹因此将个人制造工具线从 3D 打印拓展到激光加工。

拓竹 8 月首次预告 R1 时，将它定位为可处理更多材料的新工具。公司此前提供用于 H2 系列打印机的 10W 和 40W 激光模组，R1 则作为独立的激光雕刻切割产品发布。
title_en: Bambu Lab to Launch Its First Standalone Laser Engraver and Cutter, the R1
content_en:
Bambu Lab has announced that it will officially launch the R1 on September 22 at 22:00 (UTC+8). This marks the company's first-ever laser engraving and cutting machine, expanding its product lineup from 3D printing into the laser processing market.

First teased in August, the R1 is positioned as a versatile tool capable of handling a wider variety of materials. While Bambu Lab previously offered 10W and 40W add-on laser modules for its H2 series printers, the R1 will debut as a fully standalone laser engraving and cutting system.

title_zh: 飞书发布 8.0 与「豆包工作伙伴」，Agent 可直接操作文档、日程与审批
content_zh:
9 月 15 日，飞书发布 8.0 版本，向 Agent 开放数据和工具能力。用户可以把 Agent 加入群聊，Agent 也能在飞书中编辑文档、操作多维表格、安排日程与待办、参与会议、查阅云盘和妙记，以及发起审批。

飞书表示，Agent 的数据权限与其使用者一致；管理员可统一管理 Agent、追溯使用情况、限制 AI 用量，并管控高消耗模型和场景。

同期发布的「豆包工作伙伴」拥有独立身份、权限和记忆，可加入群聊并在授权范围内调用飞书与企业业务系统。该产品目前处于与企业定向共创阶段，将逐步向客户开放。
title_en: Feishu Launches Version 8.0 and "Doubao Workmate" to Empower AI Agents in the Workplace
content_en:
Feishu (Lark) has officially released version 8.0, opening up its data and tool capabilities to AI Agents. Users can now add Agents directly to group chats. These Agents are capable of editing documents, managing multidimensional tables, scheduling calendars and tasks, participating in meetings, accessing cloud drives, and initiating approval workflows.

To ensure security, Feishu stated that an Agent's data permissions will strictly align with those of its user. Administrators can centrally manage Agents, track usage history, limit AI consumption, and control high-cost models and scenarios.

Alongside the update, Feishu introduced "Doubao Workmate," an AI assistant with an independent identity, permissions, and memory. It can join group chats and call Feishu and other enterprise business systems within authorized limits. The product is currently in a co-creation phase with select enterprises and will gradually roll out to more customers.

title_zh: 联发科发布天玑 9600 Pro，首批支持 2nm、LPDDR6 与 UFS 5.0
content_zh:
联发科 9 月 15 日发布旗舰移动芯片天玑 9600 Pro。该芯片采用 2nm 制程和第四代全大核 CPU，配置两颗 Arm C2-Ultra、三颗配备 1MB 二级缓存的 C2-Pro，以及三颗配备 512KB 二级缓存的 C2-Pro。

天玑 9600 Pro 集成 NPU 1090 与低功耗 NPU 2.0：前者负责生成式 AI 和 Agent 任务，后者为后台常驻 AI 提供独立运行域。联发科称，与上一代旗舰芯片相比，其单核性能提升 17%、功耗降低 37%，多核性能提升 15%、功耗降低 61%。

芯片还首批支持 LPDDR6 与 UFS 5.0，GPU 为 Arm Mali-G2 Ultra NX，最高支持 4K 240 帧慢动作视频、H.266 硬件解码和蓝牙 6.2。OPPO Find X10 Pro Max 与 vivo X500 Pro 系列已宣布首批搭载。
title_en: MediaTek Unveils Dimensity 9600 Pro: Flagship 2nm Chip Supporting LPDDR6 and UFS 5.0
content_en:
MediaTek has officially launched its latest flagship mobile chip, the Dimensity 9600 Pro. Built on a cutting-edge 2nm process, the chip features a fourth-generation "All-Big-Core" CPU architecture, consisting of two Arm C2-Ultra cores, three C2-Pro cores (with 1MB L2 cache), and three C2-Pro cores (with 512KB L2 cache).

The Dimensity 9600 Pro integrates the NPU 1090 for generative AI and Agent tasks, alongside a low-power NPU 2.0 dedicated to always-on background AI. Compared to its predecessor, the chip delivers a 17% boost in single-core performance with 37% lower power consumption, and a 15% increase in multi-core performance with a massive 61% reduction in power usage.

Additionally, the chip is among the first to support LPDDR6 memory and UFS 5.0 storage. It features an Arm Mali-G2 Ultra NX GPU, supporting 4K 240fps slow-motion video, H.266 hardware decoding, and Bluetooth 6.2. The OPPO Find X10 Pro Max and vivo X500 Pro series have been confirmed as the first devices to adopt the new processor.

title_zh: 阶跃星辰发布 StepAudio 3，五款模型覆盖实时对话、识别与音频生成
content_zh:
9 月 15 日，阶跃星辰发布 StepAudio 3 系列，包括 Realtime、ASR、TTS、Gen 和 Music 五款语音模型，现已上线阶跃星辰开放平台。

其中，StepAudio 3 Realtime 支持原生全双工对话、打断处理，以及推理与语音生成并行；工具调用和长任务可异步执行，不阻塞当前会话。阶跃星辰引用 Artificial Analysis 榜单称，该模型的对话动态综合得分为 98.9%，语音推理准确率为 99.7%。

StepAudio 3 ASR 支持中英文、方言、中英混说、长音频及专业领域识别，在 Artificial Analysis 非流式语音识别榜单中的词错误率为 1.7%。Gen 可联合生成人声、音效、环境音和背景音乐，Music 则支持基于歌词、清唱、参考歌曲和 ABC 记谱法继续创作。
title_en: StepFun Launches StepAudio 3: Five New Models for Real-Time Dialogue, Speech Recognition, and Audio Generation
content_en:
AI startup StepFun has launched its StepAudio 3 series, introducing five advanced audio models: Realtime, ASR, TTS, Gen, and Music. The suite is now available on the StepFun Open Platform.

The flagship model, StepAudio 3 Realtime, supports native full-duplex dialogue, interruption handling, and parallel processing for reasoning and voice generation. It allows tool calling and long tasks to run asynchronously without blocking active conversations. According to Artificial Analysis, the model achieved a 98.9% score in dialogue dynamics and a 99.7% accuracy rate in speech reasoning.

Other models in the suite offer specialized capabilities. StepAudio 3 ASR supports multilingual, dialect, and domain-specific speech recognition with a low 1.7% word error rate. The Gen model can synthesize vocals, sound effects, and ambient music simultaneously, while the Music model enables music generation and continuation using lyrics, acapella inputs, or ABC notation.

title_zh: 智象未来发布视频模型 HD-V1，可生成 5～20 秒 1080p 音画内容
content_zh:
智象未来 9 月 15 日发布原生全模态视频模型 HiDream-O1-Video-1.0，简称 HD-V1。模型支持文本、图片和视频输入，可根据内容自行规划 5～20 秒时长，并直接生成带声音的 1080p 视频。

HD-V1 在生成前会把自然语言需求拆成镜头时长、场景、角色、动作、构图、运镜、台词与声音设计，再联合建模文本、视频和音频。智象未来表示，这套流程用于提高跨镜头的人物一致性、动作连续性、物理反馈和音画同步。

公司引用第三方榜单称，HD-V1 在 Artificial Analysis 的带音频图生视频榜单排名第 4，在 Arena.ai 图生视频榜单排名第 8。智象未来同期宣布完成 C+ 轮融资，投资方包括新微资本、交子资本和工银资本，未披露融资金额。
title_en: HiDream.ai Launches HD-V1 Multimodal Video Model and Secures C+ Funding
content_en:
On September 15, Chinese AI startup HiDream.ai officially launched its native multimodal video model, HiDream-O1-Video-1.0 (HD-V1). The model supports text, image, and video inputs, allowing users to generate 1080p videos with synchronized audio ranging from 5 to 20 seconds.

Unlike traditional models, HD-V1 pre-plans generation by breaking down natural language prompts into shot duration, scenes, characters, actions, composition, camera movement, dialogue, and sound design. This joint modeling of text, video, and audio significantly enhances cross-shot character consistency, motion continuity, physical feedback, and audio-video synchronization.

According to the company, HD-V1 ranks 4th on Artificial Analysis's image-to-video (with audio) leaderboard and 8th on Arena.ai's image-to-video leaderboard. Alongside the product launch, HiDream.ai announced the completion of its Series C+ funding round, backed by investors including Xinwei Capital, Jiaozi Capital, and ICBC Capital. The funding amount was not disclosed.

title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 0.1.6 增加 Browser Use 与 Computer Use
content_zh:
DeepSeek 9 月 15 日发布 DeepSeek Harness v0.1.6-alpha.1，新版加入实验性 Browser Use 和 Computer Use。前者提供 Playwright MCP、Chrome DevTools MCP 和 Stagehand 三种浏览器后端；后者可通过 Cua Driver MCP 或原生驱动操作本机并获取截图。

该版本还为 Web 侧边栏增加可恢复的多标签终端，并让 Headless 模式支持从标准输入接收任务、用 `–session-id` 续接会话，以及用 `–json` 输出逐行 JSON 运行事件。MCP 也升级至官方 SDK v2，支持协议协商、工具分页、资源读取和 URI 模板。

此次仍是面向开发者的 alpha 预览版，官方明确标注了 Browser Use、Computer Use 和 Auto review 的实验性质。
title_en: DeepSeek Harness v0.1.6-alpha.1 Introduces Experimental Browser and Computer Use Features
content_en:
DeepSeek has released DeepSeek Harness v0.1.6-alpha.1, introducing experimental "Browser Use" and "Computer Use" capabilities. Designed for developers, this alpha preview aims to expand the tool's automation and interaction limits.

The "Browser Use" feature offers three browser backends: Playwright MCP, Chrome DevTools MCP, and Stagehand. Meanwhile, "Computer Use" allows the system to control local machines and capture screenshots using either the Cua Driver MCP or native drivers.

This update also brings several developer-focused enhancements. The Web sidebar now includes a recoverable multi-tab terminal. Additionally, the Headless mode has been upgraded to receive tasks from standard input, resume sessions using `--session-id`, and output line-by-line JSON execution events via `--json`. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has also been upgraded to the official SDK v2, adding support for protocol negotiation, tool pagination, resource reading, and URI templates.

title_zh: 罗永浩差评带来意外流量，野人先生单日涨粉近 3 万
content_zh:
罗永浩 9 月 12 日在社交平台评价野人先生 Gelato「很一般」，并认为其定价与口味不匹配。内容扩散后，不少网友涌入品牌账号评论区劝其不要公开对质，相关讨论反而为品牌带来近 3 万名新增粉丝。

野人先生视频账号近 30 天累计涨粉超过 40 万。该品牌 2024 年开放加盟后加快扩张，目前全国门店超过 1700 家，并已进入香港和新加坡市场，单球产品价格多在 28～38 元。

品牌主打当日现做、低脂低糖和大米、开心果等特色口味。此前也有消费者质疑其定价和「手工现制」宣传；品牌负责人今年 1 月回应称，价格综合考虑了原料、工艺与分量，口味体验存在较强的个人偏好。
title_en: Negative Review from Luo Yonghao Sparks Unexpected Traffic Surge for Gelato Brand "Mister Wild"
content_en:
On September 12, Chinese internet celebrity Luo Yonghao criticized the Gelato brand "Mister Wild" (野人先生) on social media, calling its products "mediocre" and arguing that the taste did not justify the price. However, the criticism backfired in an unexpected way, triggering a massive wave of traffic that gained the brand nearly 30,000 new followers in a single day as netizens flooded to its account to advise against a public feud.

Mister Wild has seen rapid growth recently, gaining over 400,000 followers on its video channels over the past 30 days. After adopting a franchise model in 2024, the brand expanded aggressively, now boasting over 1,700 stores across China, alongside new locations in Hong Kong and Singapore. Its single-scoop gelatos are typically priced between 28 and 38 RMB.

Known for its freshly made, low-fat, and low-sugar offerings, the brand features unique flavors like rice and pistachio. While some consumers have previously questioned its premium pricing and "handmade" marketing claims, the brand's head responded earlier this year that the pricing reflects high-quality ingredients, craftsmanship, and portion sizes, adding that taste preferences are ultimately subjective.

title_zh: 两部门要求美团、携程等平台自查「全网最低价」风险
content_zh:
9 月 15 日，市场监管总局会同文化和旅游部召开在线酒店预订平台服务行业行政指导会。美团、抖音、京东、携程、同程、飞猪等平台负责人，以及北京、上海、江苏、浙江等地市场监管部门负责人参会。

会议要求平台遵守反垄断法、反不正当竞争法、电子商务法和旅游法，对照案例自查独家合作、「全网最低价」等竞争风险，健全长期合规机制。

监管部门将问题指向酒店经营者的自主定价与跨平台经营环境，并要求平台维护消费者权益及优质优价的市场秩序。此次会议属于行政指导，官方通报没有公布处罚或整改期限。
title_en: China Regulators Order Meituan, Ctrip to Review 'Lowest Price' Guarantees and Exclusive Deals
content_en:
China's State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the Ministry of Culture and Tourism have jointly held an administrative guidance meeting targeting major online hotel booking platforms, including Meituan, Douyin, JD.com, Ctrip, Tongcheng, and Fliggy.

Regulators ordered these platforms to comply with anti-monopoly, anti-unfair competition, e-commerce, and tourism laws. Specifically, platforms must conduct self-inspections regarding anti-competitive risks, such as demanding exclusive partnerships and guaranteeing "lowest prices across the internet."

The meeting emphasized protecting hotel operators' pricing autonomy and their ability to operate across multiple platforms, while safeguarding consumer rights. As this was an administrative guidance session, no penalties or rectification deadlines were officially announced.

title_zh: 小红书发布首份金融生态公约，禁止非法荐股与「保本保息」承诺
content_zh:
9 月 15 日，小红书发布首份《社区金融生态公约》，明确禁止恶意唱衰、非法荐股、非法金融活动、伪造权威背书、承诺「保本保息」、编造虚假投资人设和变相导流站外等八类内容。

小红书商业金融行业负责人披露，过去一年，平台金融相关内容月均发布量接近 200 万篇、月均评论约 1200 万条；金融月活用户中，75% 有搜索行为，金融产品相关搜索词同比增长超过 110%。

今年初启动金融生态专项治理后，小红书在近半年处置违规笔记超过 101 万篇、违规账号 15.7 万余个、违规评论超过 477 万条，涉及非法荐股、伪造资质、非法跨境投资导流和违规保险营销等问题。
title_en: Xiaohongshu Launches Financial Charter to Ban Illegal Stock Tips and Guaranteed Return Promises
content_en:
Xiaohongshu (RED) has released its first "Community Financial Ecosystem Charter," banning eight categories of harmful content. The prohibited activities include illegal stock recommendations, promising "guaranteed principal and returns," malicious market manipulation, fabricating investor personas, and redirecting users to external platforms.

This move comes amid surging interest in financial content on the platform. Over the past year, Xiaohongshu saw an average of nearly 2 million financial posts and 12 million comments monthly. Additionally, 75% of monthly active users in the financial segment actively search for related topics, with searches for financial products growing by over 110% year-on-year.

Following a targeted cleanup campaign launched earlier this year, Xiaohongshu has penalized over 1.01 million non-compliant posts, 157,000 accounts, and 4.77 million comments over the past six months, addressing issues like fake qualifications and illegal cross-border investment promotion.

title_zh: Apple TV 续订《流人》第八季，改编《Clown Town》
content_zh:
Apple TV 9 月 15 日宣布续订《流人》第八季。新一季共 6 集，改编自 Mick Herron「Slough House」系列第九部小说《Clown Town》，Gary Oldman 将继续饰演 Jackson Lamb。

第八季将围绕 Jackson Lamb 与 Diana Taverner 的正面冲突展开，Ben Vanstone 负责剧集改编与执行制片，Adam Randall 回归执导。该剧第六季将于 9 月 16 日开播，第七季已于去年获续订。
title_en: Apple TV+ Renews 'Slow Horses' for Season 8, Adapting Mick Herron's 'Clown Town'
content_en:
Apple TV+ has officially renewed its hit spy drama *Slow Horses* for an eighth season. The upcoming six-episode season will adapt *Clown Town*, the ninth novel in Mick Herron’s acclaimed "Slough House" literary series. Gary Oldman is set to return as the slovenly but brilliant intelligence chief Jackson Lamb.

Season 8 will focus on a direct, high-stakes clash between Jackson Lamb and Diana Taverner. Ben Vanstone will handle the adaptation and serve as executive producer, while Adam Randall is set to return as director.

The renewal comes ahead of the show's sixth season premiere on September 16, with a seventh season having already been greenlit last year.

title_zh: Netflix 新版《傲慢与偏见》定档 12 月 3 日上线
content_zh:
Netflix 9 月 15 日宣布，新版《傲慢与偏见》限定剧将于 12 月 3 日上线，共 6 集。编剧 Dolly Alderton 表示，剧集将贴近简·奥斯汀 1813 年的原著，同时在人物与表达上作出部分新调整。

Emma Corrin 饰演伊丽莎白·班纳特，Jack Lowden 饰演达西，Olivia Colman 与 Rufus Sewell 分别饰演班纳特夫妇。剧集由《心跳漏一拍》导演 Euros Lyn 执导，Alderton、Lyn 与 Corrin 等人担任执行制片。

Netflix 同步公布了 11 名主要角色的首批剧照。Freya Mavor 饰演简·班纳特，Daryl McCormack 饰演宾利，Louis Partridge 饰演威克姆；这也是该平台今年重点推出的经典文学改编项目之一。
title_en: Netflix's New 'Pride and Prejudice' Adaptation Set for December Premiere
content_en:
Netflix has announced that its highly anticipated limited series adaptation of *Pride and Prejudice* will premiere on December 3. The six-episode series, written by Dolly Alderton, aims to stay faithful to Jane Austen’s classic 1813 novel while introducing fresh nuances to the characters and their dialogue.

The star-studded cast features Emma Corrin as Elizabeth Bennet and Jack Lowden as Mr. Darcy, alongside Oscar-winner Olivia Colman and Rufus Sewell as Mr. and Mrs. Bennet. Other key cast members include Freya Mavor as Jane Bennet, Daryl McCormack as Mr. Bingley, and Louis Partridge as Mr. Wickham.

Directed by Euros Lyn (*Heartstopper*), who also serves as an executive producer alongside Alderton and Corrin, the series is one of Netflix's flagship literary adaptations of the year. Alongside the release date, Netflix has unveiled the first-look images of 11 main characters.
